subject: feat(rmos): add glob fallback for attachment resolution (Decision B)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(rmos): add GET /index/attachment_meta browse endpoint
body:
New endpoint to browse global sha256→meta index without run_id:
- GET /api/rmos/acoustics/index/attachment_meta
- Filters: kind (exact match), mime_prefix (prefix match)
- Limit: 1-1000 rows (default 200)
- Sorted by last_seen_at_utc descending (newest first)
- No path disclosure, auth-gated

Response schema: AttachmentMetaBrowseOut
- count, total_in_index, limit
- kind_filter, mime_prefix_filter (echo applied filters)
- entries: List[AttachmentMetaIndexEntry]

Use cases:
- UI browsing attachments without knowing run_id
- Filtering by kind (e.g., "spectrum_csv", "audio_raw")
- Filtering by MIME prefix (e.g., "audio/", "image/")

subject: ci: Add routing truth gate with self-validation and endpoint auto-detect
body:
Implements ROUTING_TRUTH_CONTRACT_v1 CI enforcement:

- check_routing_truth.py: Compares endpoint_truth.json against runtime
  - Self-validating: fails loudly if truth JSON schema is wrong
  - Auto-detects routing-truth endpoint path (tries 3 common paths)
  - Lane-based policy: CORE,META,OPERATION,RMOS fail; others warn
  - Env overrides for API_URL, TRUTH_FILE, ENDPOINT_PATH, FAIL_LANES

- validate_endpoint_truth.py: Lightweight local JSON schema validator
  - Checks required fields: path, methods, name, lane, deprecated
  - Type validation for all fields

- routing_truth.yml: Standalone GitHub Actions workflow
  - Runs on PR and push to main
  - Auto-detects pyproject.toml vs requirements.txt (PIP_INSTALL_CMD override)
  - Auto-detects routing-truth endpoint with 80x retry loop
  - Deterministic isolation via runner.temp paths

subject: ci: Add routing truth gate with self-validation and endpoint auto-detect
body:
Implements ROUTING_TRUTH_CONTRACT_v1 CI enforcement:

- check_routing_truth.py: Compares endpoint_truth.json against runtime
  - Self-validating: fails loudly if truth JSON schema is wrong
  - Auto-detects routing-truth endpoint path (tries 3 common paths)
  - Lane-based policy: CORE,META,OPERATION,RMOS fail; others warn
  - Env overrides for API_URL, TRUTH_FILE, ENDPOINT_PATH, FAIL_LANES

- validate_endpoint_truth.py: Lightweight local JSON schema validator
  - Checks required fields: path, methods, name, lane, deprecated
  - Type validation for all fields

- routing_truth.yml: Standalone GitHub Actions workflow
  - Runs on PR and push to main
  - Auto-detects pyproject.toml vs requirements.txt (PIP_INSTALL_CMD override)
  - Auto-detects routing-truth endpoint with 80x retry loop
  - Deterministic isolation via runner.temp paths

author: HanzoRazer
subject: refactor: Phase 1 advisory neutral zone migration
body:
Create app/advisory/ as the shared domain for advisory types and storage,
implementing the Bi-Directional Workflow Architect's recommendation.

Architecture:
- app/advisory/ (NEUTRAL): schemas, store - both AI sandbox and RMOS can import
- app/rmos/handoff.py (NARROW INTERFACE): get_run, attach_advisory, find_runs_with_advisory
- _experimental/ai_graphics/ (AI SANDBOX): image_providers, generation logic

Changes:
- Create app/advisory/schemas.py with all advisory types
- Create app/advisory/store.py with AdvisoryAssetStore
- Create app/advisory/__init__.py with re-exports
- Create app/rmos/handoff.py as narrow RMOS interface for AI sandbox
- Update _experimental schemas/store to re-export from neutral zone
- Update advisory_routes.py to import from neutral zone and handoff

This maintains the bidirectional sandbox boundary:
- AI sandbox cannot import RMOS authority modules (except handoff)
- RMOS cannot import from AI sandbox
- Shared types live in neutral app/advisory/

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(cam): add two-lane architecture to roughing G-code endpoint
body:
Implements draft/governed lane pattern for CAM G-code centralization:

- Extract `generate_roughing_program()` as single source of truth
- `/gcode` endpoint: draft lane with X-ToolBox-Lane header (no RMOS)
- `/gcode_governed` endpoint: governed lane with full RMOS persistence
  - Creates RunArtifact matching adaptive pocket contract
  - SHA256 hashes for request and G-code output
  - Returns X-Run-ID and X-GCode-SHA256 headers

This is the template migration pattern for centralizing all 24 legacy
G-code endpoints through RMOS governance.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

subject: feat(governance): add Architecture Scan Harness (Phase 1)
body:
Non-blocking CI scanner that detects structural risk signals and
invariant violations. Integrates with CBSP21 as a separate detection
layer.

Components:
- scripts/architecture/scan_architecture.py (read-only scanner)
- .github/workflows/architecture_scan.yml (non-blocking CI)
- docs/architecture/invariants.md (v1 invariant definitions)
- docs/architecture/findings.md (human-curated registry template)

Invariants checked:
- GCODE_TRACEABLE: Machine output must be traceable
- AI_NO_AUTHORITY: Experimental code can't create authority
- ADVISORY_ATTACHED: Advisories must link to parent run

Initial scan results (145 findings):
- Critical: 2 (AI sandbox authority violations)
- High: 46 (G-code/DXF traceability breaks)
- Medium: 97 (multi-authority signals, advisory linkage)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(arch-scan): ignore docstrings/comments for authority-critical signals
body:
Problem:
The architecture scanner flagged files in _experimental/ as CRITICAL when
authority keywords (e.g. compute_feasibility) appeared only in comments or
docstrings, not executable code. This caused false-positive AI_NO_AUTHORITY
violations in advisory-only AI graphics modules.

Solution:
Enhance strip_comments() to remove Python docstrings (""" / ''') and line
comments (#, //) before evaluating authority-critical signals. Policy
decisions now operate on comment-stripped text while preserving raw text
for reporting.

Behavioral changes:
- Authority keywords in documentation → ignored for critical classification
- Authority keywords in executable code → still flagged
- ID_CREATION only triggers critical when RMOS-style authority (run_id /
  create_run_id) is detected

Changes:
- Add regex-based docstring stripping to strip_comments()
- Refine critical and INV-002 logic to distinguish advisory UUIDs vs RMOS IDs
- Add 6 new strip_comments tests
- Split and refine ID_CREATION / INV-002 tests
- Test count: 68 → 76 (all passing)
- Critical findings: 2 → 0

This preserves strict sandbox policy enforcement while eliminating
documentation-driven false positives.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(rmos): implement hybrid architecture for AI → RMOS flow
body:
Hybrid Architecture:
- Producer Plane (Vision): Creates assets, writes to CAS, returns sha256
- Ledger Plane (RMOS): Attaches sha256 to runs, governs review/promote

Key Contracts:
- Identity: advisory_id always equals sha256
- State: reviewed/rejected/promoted live ONLY in RMOS run ledger
- Storage: advisory_inputs[] embedded on runs (not separate file)

Canonical Endpoints:
- POST /api/rmos/runs/{run_id}/advisory/attach (canonical attach)
- POST /api/rmos/runs/{run_id}/advisory/{advisory_id}/review (unified review)
- POST /api/rmos/runs/{run_id}/advisory/bulk-review
- POST /api/rmos/runs/{run_id}/advisory/{advisory_id}/promote
- GET /api/rmos/runs/{run_id}/manufacturing/candidates (projection)
- GET /api/rmos/runs/{run_id}/advisory/blobs/{sha256}/download

Vision Stubs (Phase A):
- POST /api/vision/generate (returns sha256)
- POST /api/vision/prompt
- GET /api/vision/providers

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(rmos): extend AdvisoryInputRef with review fields
body:
Extends the canonical AdvisoryInputRef schema to include review state:
- status: VariantStatus (NEW|REVIEWED|PROMOTED|REJECTED)
- rejected: bool + rejection_reason_code/detail/operator_note
- rating: 1-5 star rating
- notes: Operator notes
- risk_level: Quick triage level
- promoted: bool + promoted_candidate_id

This eliminates drift by storing review state directly in the run ledger
rather than a parallel advisory_reviews[] structure.

Backward compatible: existing runs without these fields get defaults.

Also adds:
- VariantStatus and RejectReasonCode type aliases
- Field validators for status/risk_level/rejection_reason_code
- Defensive rejected=False in promote endpoint
- Alignment comment in advisory_schemas.py

subject: fix(dxf): resolve LogRecord conflict and DFS path explosion
body:
Cluster 3 Fix: DXF Security Patch

1. dxf_upload_guard.py:
   - Rename 'filename' to 'upload_filename' in logger.warning() extra
     to avoid Python LogRecord reserved attribute collision
   - Change file_size > to >= for boundary check consistency with tests

2. graph_algorithms.py:
   - Replace path-enumerating iterative DFS with linear-time O(V+E)
     parent-pointer cycle detector
   - Prevents combinatorial explosion on dense graphs (many-paths)
   - Uses back-edge detection instead of path enumeration
   - Maintains depth limit safety fuse

All 23 DXF security patch tests now pass.

subject: feat: add ToolBox -> Smart Guitar safe export contract
body:
Contract: TOOLBOX_SMART_GUITAR_EXPORT_v1

Teaching/learning content export that is explicitly "Smart Guitar-safe":
- Read-only / non-authoritative (no decisions, no governance state)
- Non-manufacturing (no G-code, no toolpaths, no CNC settings)
- Content-addressed (SHA256 hashes for integrity)
- Composable (can add scanned-book content later)

New files:
- contracts/toolbox_smart_guitar_safe_export_v1.schema.json
- services/api/app/smart_guitar_export/ (schemas, validator, exporter)
- 17 gate tests enforcing boundary
- CI workflow: smart_guitar_export_gate.yml

Forbidden content (enforced by gate):
- .nc, .gcode, .dxf, .toolpath extensions
- RMOS artifacts, run IDs, decisions
- Secrets (.pem, .key, .env)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat: add telemetry cost attribution bundle v1
body:
Maps validated Smart Guitar telemetry to internal manufacturing cost dimensions.
Treats telemetry as untrusted input -> validated -> mapped -> internal cost facts.

New endpoint:
- GET /api/cost/summary?manufacturing_batch_id=...
- GET /api/cost/summary?instrument_id=...

Bundle contents:
- contracts/telemetry_cost_mapping_policy_v1.json - allowed mappings + forbidden substrings
- services/api/app/cost_attribution/ - new module (models, policy, mapper, store, api)
- Telemetry ingest hook - auto-maps to cost facts on successful ingestion
- 10 unit tests for mapper logic

Cost dimensions:
- compute_cost_hours (from hardware_performance.cpu_hours)
- energy_amp_hours (from hardware_performance.amp_draw_avg)
- thermal_stress_c (from hardware_performance.temp_c_max)
- wear_cycles (from lifecycle.power_cycles)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(ai-context): add POST /build endpoint with hard boundary gate
body:
Add bounded context assembly endpoint for AI consumption:
POST /api/ai/context/build

Key features:
- Explicit include allowlist (rosette_param_spec, manufacturing_candidates, etc.)
- Hard boundary gate enforces NO toolpaths/gcode/manufacturing secrets
- Feature flag: AI_CONTEXT_ENABLED (default: true)
- User notes kept separate for fencing

Boundary rules:
- Forbidden keys: toolpaths, gcode, gcode_text, nc_program, etc.
- Forbidden patterns: G-code commands (G0x, Mxx), coordinates
- Violations raise HTTP 500 boundary_violation

Response schema:
- schema_id: toolbox_ai_context
- schema_version: v1
- context_id, summary, context, warnings

Test coverage:
- 12 tests passing (unit + integration)
- Boundary gate violations tested
- Safe content passage tested

- Override included in operator pack ZIP
- Existing override allows subsequent exports without re-override

subject: feat(saw-lab): CAM hardening bundle - lint, auto-gate execution, machine profile bounds
body:
1. Machine profile resolver (machine_profile_resolver.py):
   - Reads safe_z_mm and bounds_mm from machine profile artifact
   - Used by validate/lint/execution endpoints

2. Validate endpoint extended (toolpaths_validate_router.py):
   - New machine_profile_artifact_id parameter
   - Overrides safe_z_mm/bounds_mm from profile payload
   - Stamps applied constraints in summary for UI

3. Lint report artifact (toolpaths_lint_service.py + router):
   - POST /api/saw/batch/toolpaths/lint
   - Validates and persists saw_toolpaths_lint_report artifact
   - Returns lint_artifact_id + ok/errors/warnings/summary

4. Auto-gate execution (execution_start_from_toolpaths_router.py):
   - POST /api/saw/batch/execution/start-from-toolpaths
   - Runs lint first if validate_first=true
   - Writes BLOCKED execution artifact if lint fails
   - Writes OK execution artifact if lint passes
   - Always creates audit trail

5. Tests:
   - test_toolpaths_lint_writes_artifact_unit.py

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(docker): two-stage pip install to prevent total failure on sg-spec auth
body:
Problem: pip resolves all dependencies before installing, so when sg-spec
clone fails (missing SG_SPEC_TOKEN), the ENTIRE pip install fails and
uvicorn/fastapi aren't installed. Container crashes with "No module named uvicorn".

Fix:
- Stage 1: Install all core deps (grep -v sg-spec) - always succeeds
- Stage 2: Install sg-spec separately using .netrc auth (more reliable than git config)
- If SG_SPEC_TOKEN missing, warn but continue (container starts without sg-spec)

This ensures the API container always starts, even without private repo access.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(saw-lab): tighten execution complete guardrail to require qualifying job log
body:
Qualifying job log must:
- Be parented to the execution
- Have status != 'ABORTED'
- Have work evidence in metrics (parts_ok + parts_scrap > 0, or cut_time_s > 0, or total_time_s > 0)

This prevents completion when only abort-style notes or empty metrics exist.

- Add _payload() helper to extract payload from artifact dict
- Add _metrics_indicate_work() to check for work evidence
- Update test fixtures with proper status + metrics
- Add test_execution_complete_409_when_job_log_not_qualifying

body:
Single entry point for all boundary fence checks:
- python -m app.ci.check_all_fences              # baseline mode (default)
- python -m app.ci.check_all_fences --strict     # strict mode (no baselines)
- python -m app.ci.check_all_fences --write-baselines  # regenerate baselines

Options:
- --imports-only: run only import-based checks

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(rmos): add Run Log audit surface (Wave 22.2)
body:
Add flattened, human- and machine-readable audit log for manufacturing runs.

New module: services/api/app/rmos/logs/
- schemas.py: RunLogEntry model with CSV_COLUMNS
- projector.py: RunArtifact → RunLogEntry transformation
- exporters.py: JSONL (authoritative) + CSV (convenience) export
- router.py: API endpoints

Endpoints:
- GET /api/rmos/run-logs/latest - recent entries with risk filter
- GET /api/rmos/run-logs/export.csv - download CSV
- GET /api/rmos/run-logs/export.json - download JSONL
- GET /api/rmos/run-logs/summary - aggregate statistics
- GET /api/rmos/run-logs/overrides - runs with manual overrides

Design principles:
- Append-only: never mutates history
- Deterministic: derived from RunArtifact
- Schema-stable: new fields append, old never change
- Lossy by design: log is audit surface, not source of truth

This is the spine for the 30-run validation protocol.

subject: feat(rmos): add adversarial detection rules (F020-F029) — 0 red leaks
body:
Schema v2 Extension (FeasibilityInput):
- Add MaterialHardness enum (soft/medium/hard/very-hard/extreme)
- Add material_id, material_hardness, material_thickness_mm, material_resinous
- Add geometry_width_mm, geometry_length_mm, geometry_depth_mm, wall_thickness_mm
- Add tool_flute_length_mm, tool_stickout_mm
- Add coolant_enabled

New RED Rules (adversarial blocking):
- F020: Excessive DOC in hardwood (stepdown > 1.5x tool_d in hard material)
- F021: Tool breakage risk (DOC:diameter > 5:1)
- F022: Depth exceeds material thickness
- F023: Zero/negative geometry dimensions
- F024: Missing material specification
- F025: Tool larger than pocket width
- F026: Chatter/deflection risk (stickout:diameter > 5:1 hardwood, >8:1 soft)
- F027: Thermal risk (resinous + small tool + no coolant)
- F028: Structural wall failure (< 1mm)
- F029: Combined adversarial (3+ risk factors)

- Pass all v2 fields through to FeasibilityInput
- Handle null material (adversarial-25)

New YELLOW rules for edge pressure detection:

subject: feat(rmos): wire ai-integrator CLI as subprocess
body:
RMOS AI Advisory module for invoking ai-integrator CLI:
- config.py: env-based config (AI_INTEGRATOR_BIN, TIMEOUT, WORKDIR)

- store.py: date-partitioned artifact persistence
- service.py: request_advisory() business logic

- RMOS is the ONLY caller of ai-integrator (ToolBox never calls directly)
- v1 supports only 'explanation' request kind
- Provenance via context_packet_sha256 in artifact

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(ci): add self-executing deprecation sunset governance
body:
Add governance structure that makes route removal self-executing:

1. deprecation_registry.json - Source of truth for deprecated routes
   - Tracks sunset dates for all deprecated/compat routes
   - Requires 'governance' label to modify (enforced by CI)

2. check_deprecation_sunset.py - CI enforcement script
   - Runs on every PR and daily via cron
   - FAILS CI when routes are past their sunset date
   - Warns about routes sunsetting within 30 days
   - Exit code 1 = blocking (must remove or extend with governance label)

3. deprecation_sunset_guard.yml - GitHub Actions workflow
   - Scheduled daily at 9am UTC
   - Runs on PRs touching services/api/app/**
   - Requires 'governance' label to change registry

This makes removal self-executing:
- Set sunset date when deprecating
- CI warns as deadline approaches
- CI blocks merges after deadline
- Must either remove the route OR get governance approval to extend

Registered routes:
- 3 legacy redirect routers (sunset 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-01)
- 7 compat mounts (sunset 2026-06-01)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

ratio_set_id and requires explicit per-fret ratios to prevent accidental
key-locked fretboards.

- Actual ratio_set_id value
- Observed ratios[] length (0 if none)
- Required fret_count for explicit ratios

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(saw-lab): close physics layer gaps — 7 calculators, beam theory, thermodynamics
body:
New calculators:
- saw_cutting_force.py: C-axis force decomposition (Ft/Fr/Ff),
  MRR computation, specific cutting energy method, power feasibility check
- saw_blade_dynamics.py: clamped-free annular plate model,
  natural frequencies for first 3 vibration modes, critical speed detection

Upgraded calculators:
- saw_deflection.py: Euler-Bernoulli beam theory replaces bucket factors.
  Uses radial force Fr, unsupported length, blade thickness, Young's modulus.
  delta = Fr * L^3 / (3 * E * I)
- saw_heat.py: thermodynamic model replaces bucket factors.
  Cutting power -> heat partition -> thermal penetration -> temperature rise.
  Detects rubbing regime (feed/tooth < 0.02 mm)

Model extensions (backward-compatible defaults):
- SawContext: blade_thickness_mm, machine_power_kw, blade_youngs_modulus_gpa
- MaterialProperties: specific_cutting_energy, thermal_conductivity, specific_heat

Infrastructure fixes:
- toolpath_builder: trapezoidal velocity profile (accel/cruise/decel)
  replaces flat 15% overhead
- tuning_decision_service: actually applies rpm_mul/feed_mul/doc_mul
  to machining parameters (was placeholder)
- batch_router: _extract_base_context() reads spec/plan artifacts
  instead of hardcoded nominals {3000 RPM, 600 mm/min, 3mm DOC}

Bundle: 7 calculators with redistributed weights:
  cutting_force 18%, heat 15%, bite_load 15%, kickback 15%,
  rim_speed 13%, deflection 12%, blade_dynamics 12%

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(saw-lab): wire queue placeholder to SQLite joblog store
body:
Replace in-memory queue with persistent SQLite-backed implementation:
- enqueue() creates job with status "pending"
- dequeue() gets oldest pending, marks as "running"
- complete()/fail() mark jobs done with results
- requeue() moves failed jobs back to pending
- snapshot() lists all pending jobs
- history() returns completed/failed jobs
- Add peek(), running(), size(), clear_pending() helpers
- Add get_saw_lab_queue() singleton factory

Enables durable job queue that survives API restarts.

subject: fix(security): fail closed on malformed override token expiry dates
body:
Before: Malformed expires_at would silently pass (except Exception: pass)
After: Malformed expires_at rejects the override token (fail closed)

This prevents security bypass where a crafted/corrupted expiry date
could allow an override token to be used indefinitely.

WP-1 Tier 1B: Safety-critical exception handling hardening

subject: docs(spine): replace event type checklist with comprehensive 10-step version
body:
Improved checklist with governance-focused guidance:
1. Start with contract, not code (prefer user_action first)
2. Additive only (old agents must handle new events)
3. Define minimal payload schema
4. Update fixtures first
5. Ensure contract parity tests pass
6. Decide if moment detector should care
7. Decide if policy engine should care
8. Decide if UWSM should update from it
9. Run full spine suite before merging
10. Versioning rule (minor for add, major for remove)

Rule of thumb: if you can't write fixture + test first, event type isn't ready.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(agentic): implement Option B for stable directive UX
body:
Fix two critical M1 Advisory Mode bugs:

Bug 1: FINDING masks FIRST_SIGNAL on initial pack load
- Add FIRST_SIGNAL_GRACE_MS (1500ms) constant
- Add selectMomentWithGrace() to synthesize FIRST_SIGNAL during grace window
- Ensures FTUE shows "Inspect this" before "Review this"

Bug 2: Dismissed directives resurrect
- Add makeDirectiveKey() for stable directive identity (moment|rule_id|triggers)
- Add dismissedKeys Set to track dismissed directive keys
- Keys added to dismissedKeys on dismiss/feedback, never shown again

New state fields:
- lastDirectiveKey: current directive key for deduplication
- dismissedKeys: Set of dismissed directive keys (prevents resurrection)
- firstSignalShown: tracks if FIRST_SIGNAL was already shown
- firstViewRenderedAt: timestamp for grace window calculation
- latestMoment: current detected moment

Updated functions:
- emitEvent: tracks firstViewRenderedAt on view_rendered
- updateDecisionImmediate: applies grace window + key-based dedupe
- dismissDirective/submitFeedback: add keys to dismissedKeys
- clearSession: resets all new state

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(agentic): tighten Option B patches for determinism + resurrection prevention
body:
Three surgical fixes:

1. makeDirectiveKey: sort trigger IDs for determinism
   - Trigger event order can vary; sorting ensures stable keys
   - Remove emit_directive guard (compute key regardless)

2. selectMomentWithGrace: prefer existing FIRST_SIGNAL from moments list
   - If FINDING is top but FIRST_SIGNAL exists in list, use it
   - If neither, suppress during grace window (show nothing briefly)
   - Simpler than synthesizing; removes events parameter

3. updateDecisionImmediate: tighten resurrection prevention
   - Set latestDecision BEFORE checking emit_directive
   - Only compute key when decision.emit_directive is true
   - Clear dismissed=false ONLY for genuinely new directiveKey
   - Same-key recomputation no longer resets dismissed state

These prevent:
- Key instability from trigger order variation
- Resurrection when latestMoment/decision drift
- Flicker from clearing dismissed on every emit_directive=true

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(agentic): add one-shot FIRST_SIGNAL + 10s cooldown between directives
body:
Two UX improvements for M1 advisory mode:

1. One-shot FIRST_SIGNAL suppression
   - FIRST_SIGNAL is now strictly once-per-session
   - If firstSignalShown=true, selectMomentWithGrace skips to next moment
   - Prevents FTUE bubble from reappearing on new view_rendered events

2. Directive cooldown (prevents nagging)
   - Add DIRECTIVE_COOLDOWN_MS = 10000 (10 seconds)
   - Add CRITICAL_MOMENTS set: ERROR, OVERLOAD, DECISION_REQUIRED
   - Non-critical moments suppressed if within cooldown
   - Critical moments always bypass cooldown (safety first)
   - Track lastDirectiveShownAt for cooldown calculation

New state:
- lastDirectiveShownAt: timestamp of last shown directive

Updated flow in updateDecisionImmediate:
1. Check dismissed keys
2. Check same key (no flicker)
3. Check cooldown for non-critical ← NEW
4. Accept new directive, set lastDirectiveShownAt

This makes M1 feel calm and human:
- Show FIRST_SIGNAL once on load
- Wait 10s before showing FINDING/HESITATION
- Always show ERROR/OVERLOAD/DECISION_REQUIRED immediately

author: HanzoRazer
subject: ci(release): add two-tier policy verification + cross-version replay
body:
Part A — Always-on PR/push gate (.github/workflows/verify-policy.yml):
- Runs on every PR and push to main
- Executes spine tests + verify-policy against repo fixtures
- Blocks merges that regress policy behavior

Part B — Release workflow enhancements (publish-images.yml):

1. verify-policy job (pre-release gate):
   - Runs spine tests
   - Verifies policy against fixtures
   - Packages fixtures as agentic-sessions-{tag}.zip
   - Uploads as workflow artifact

2. cross-version-replay job (NEW):
   - Downloads previous release's session bundle
   - Verifies current code handles old sessions
   - continue-on-error: true (graceful for first releases)

3. create-release job:
   - Attaches agentic-sessions-{tag}.zip to GitHub Release
   - Includes verification instructions in release notes

New tooling:
- tools/package_sessions.sh: bundles JSONL fixtures into zip

Naming convention:
- Asset: agentic-sessions-toolbox-v0.35.0.zip
- Contents: *.jsonl session fixtures

Local developer workflow:
  gh release download toolbox-v0.35.0 --pattern "agentic-sessions-*.zip"
  unzip ... -d release-assets/sessions/
  make verify-policy RELEASE_SESSIONS=release-assets/sessions/

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(ci): fix Docker metadata tag patterns for toolbox-v* tags
body:
The metadata-action was generating invalid tags like "-58306e9" because:
1. semver patterns expected v*.*.* but we use toolbox-v*.*.*
2. sha prefix used {{branch}} which is empty on tag pushes

Fixes:
- Use type=ref,event=tag to capture full tag name (toolbox-v0.35.0)
- Change sha prefix from {{branch}}- to sha- (always valid)
- Enable latest tag on any tag push, not just default branch

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(tests): correct singleton reset in delete audit test fixtures
body:
The test fixtures were clearing store._default_store, but due to Python
import semantics, this only rebinds the name in store.py without affecting
store_api._default_store (where the singleton actually lives).

After importlib.reload(store_module), the _default_store was re-imported
from store_api, which still held the old RunStoreV2 instance pointing to
the wrong RMOS_RUNS_DIR.

Fixes:
- Clear store_api._default_store directly before reloading store
- Reload store_ratelimit before store to pick up rate limit env vars
  (DELETE_RATE_LIMIT_MAX is read at import time)

All 6 delete audit tests now pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(agentic): implement selective suppression in moments engine
body:
The initial fix (d86c8cf) suppressed ALL lower-priority moments, which
broke the grace selector tests that expect to see both FINDING and
FIRST_SIGNAL to apply FTUE preferences.

New suppression rules:
- ERROR or OVERLOAD: Full suppression (only that moment returned)
- Other moments: All returned for grace selector to choose

This satisfies both requirements:
1. test_error_has_highest_priority (ERROR suppresses everything)
2. test_priority_overload_beats_decision_required (OVERLOAD suppresses)
3. test_grace_selector_prefers_first_signal (grace selector sees both)

All 34 moments + golden_m1_replay tests pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

subject: feat(health): Phase 10 startup validation for safety-critical modules
body:
Add fail-fast startup validation that blocks the server if safety-critical
modules fail to import. No more silent degradation.

New module: app/health/
- startup.py: validate_startup() checks required modules at boot
- Fails with RuntimeError if any required module missing
- Logs warnings for optional modules

Safety-critical modules (required):
- app.rmos.feasibility.engine (risk assessment)
- app.rmos.feasibility.rules (safety constraints)
- app.rmos.runs_v2.store (audit trail)
- app.saw_lab.batch_router (saw operations)

Optional modules (warnings only):
- app.ai.transport.image_client
- app.cam.routers
- app.compare.routers

main.py changes:
- Add _startup_safety_validation() as first startup event
- Controlled by RMOS_STRICT_STARTUP env var (default: strict)

health_router.py changes:
- Add GET /health/modules endpoint for module status

subject: refactor(rmos): extract AdvisoryLinkStore from RunStoreV2 (SRP)
body:
Extract advisory subsystem from RunStoreV2 god object into dedicated
AdvisoryLinkStore class using composition pattern.

Before: RunStoreV2 had 25 methods (god object threshold: 15)
After: RunStoreV2 has 18 methods (5 are thin delegation wrappers)

New module: advisory_link_store.py (253 lines)
- put_advisory_link, list_run_advisories, resolve_advisory
- attach_advisory, load_advisory_links
- 4 internal helpers for index/lookup management

Design:
- Callback injection for read_index, write_index, get_artifact
- No circular dependencies
- Public API unchanged (backward compatible)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(ci): add technical debt gate checks with ratchet baselines
body:
Add three CI-ready debt gate checks:

check_complexity.py:
- Cyclomatic complexity > 15 threshold
- Uses radon library for AST-based analysis
- 150 violations baselined (worst: validate_gcode_static at 62)

check_file_sizes.py:
- File size > 500 lines threshold
- 6 violations baselined (4 test files, 2 production)

check_bare_except.py:
- Detects bare except: clauses (catches KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit)
- 0 violations (clean!)

All checks support:
- --baseline FILE: ratchet mode (fail only on NEW violations)
- --write-baseline: snapshot current violations
- --json: machine-readable output
- --threshold N: override default (complexity/file size)

subject: feat(api): add curated API v1 with 17 golden-path endpoints
body:
Create stable, documented API surface at /api/v1/* for core workflows:

DXF → G-code (5 endpoints):
- POST /dxf/upload - Upload and parse DXF
- POST /dxf/validate - Validate geometry for CAM
- POST /cam/plan - Create CAM operation plan
- POST /cam/gcode - Generate G-code
- GET  /cam/posts - List post-processors

Fret Math (3 endpoints):
- POST /frets/positions - Calculate fret positions
- POST /frets/slots - Generate slot cutting params
- GET  /frets/temperaments - List temperament options

RMOS Safety (5 endpoints):
- POST /rmos/check - Quick feasibility check
- GET  /rmos/rules - List all rules
- POST /rmos/runs - Create tracked run
- GET  /rmos/runs/{id} - Get run status
- POST /rmos/runs/{id}/approve - Override YELLOW

Instrument Design (4 endpoints):
- GET  /scale-lengths - Reference database
- POST /neck-profile - Calculate neck dimensions
- POST /body-geometry - Body outline calcs
- GET  /wood-species - Wood properties

All endpoints use consistent {ok, data, error, hint} response format.

Phase 2.1 progress: 17 of 40 target endpoints.

subject: feat(analytics): add route analytics middleware for router consolidation
body:
Add middleware to capture real route usage data for informed router
consolidation decisions.

New files:
- app/middleware/route_analytics_middleware.py: Captures route usage metrics
- app/router_rewire_report/: Initial router analysis (188 files, 378 routes)

Endpoints added:
- GET /api/_analytics/summary - Top/bottom routes by usage
- GET /api/_analytics/export - Full JSON for router harness
- GET /api/_analytics/zero-usage - Routes never called
- POST /api/_analytics/reset - Clear and restart collection

Workflow:
1. Deploy to Railway
2. Use app normally for 1 week
3. Export analytics JSON
4. Re-run router harness with real data
5. Make informed consolidation decisions

Initial analysis found:
- 188 router files
- 378 total routes
- 42 duplicate paths needing consolidation

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(railway): use dynamic $PORT env var for API service
body:
Railway assigns PORT dynamically (usually 8080). The Dockerfile was
hardcoding --port 8000, causing healthchecks to fail (app listens on
8000, Railway checks 8080).

Changes:
- Default PORT to 8080 (Railway standard)
- Use shell form CMD to allow $PORT expansion at runtime
- Update EXPOSE and HEALTHCHECK to use $PORT

This fixes "healthcheck timeout" deployment failures.

subject: fix(client): add VITE_API_BASE support for cross-origin Railway deployment
body:
All ai_images API clients now use VITE_API_BASE environment variable
for cross-origin deployments. Without this, API calls go to the client
domain instead of the API domain, returning HTML 404 instead of JSON.

Fixed files:
- api.ts: Use BASE + /api pattern
- advisory.ts: Already had correct pattern
- ai.ts: Use BASE + /api/ai pattern
- http.ts: Added resolveUrl helper (existing)
- session.ts: Use BASE + /api/ai/session pattern
- teaching.ts: Use BASE + /api/teaching pattern
- visionApi.ts: Add API_BASE prefix to all fetch calls

This enables Railway split deployment (client + API on separate services).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

This enables Railway split deployment (client + API on separate services).

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(client): add global fetch interceptor for cross-origin API calls
body:
Instead of fixing 84+ files with hardcoded /api/* paths, add a global
fetch interceptor in main.ts that automatically prepends VITE_API_BASE
to all requests starting with /api/.

This fixes ALL API calls in one place:
- Components with fetch('/api/...')
- Views with fetch('/api/...')
- Any future code with hardcoded paths

The interceptor only activates when VITE_API_BASE is set (production).
Local development (no VITE_API_BASE) continues to work unchanged.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(ci): add API contract validation system
body:
Prevents frontend-backend drift by validating API calls match endpoints.

New files:
- contracts/api_endpoints.json - Source of truth for endpoints
- contracts/api_calls_baseline.json - Baseline for gradual cleanup
- contracts/README.md - Documentation
- scripts/validate_api_contracts.py - Validation script
- scripts/generate_api_contract.py - Contract generator from FastAPI
- .github/workflows/api_contract_check.yml - CI workflow

Features:
- Scans frontend for fetch('/api/...') calls
- Validates against contract endpoint definitions
- Baseline mode: only fails on NEW violations
- Catches: wrong paths, missing endpoints, unregistered routers

Usage:
  python scripts/validate_api_contracts.py              # Full validation
  python scripts/validate_api_contracts.py --baseline X # Baseline mode
  python scripts/validate_api_contracts.py --write-baseline

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(docker): set RMOS_RUNS_DIR env var for Railway deployment
body:
The RMOS runs store was failing with 500 errors because it tried to use
the default path `services/api/data/runs/rmos` which doesn't exist in
the container context.

Fix:
- Create /app/app/data/runs/rmos directory structure
- Set RMOS_RUNS_DIR=/app/app/data/runs/rmos env var
- This points the store to the writable container path

This fixes the /api/rmos/runs 500 errors that were causing CORS failures
(CORS headers aren't added on error responses).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix: replace mutable default arguments with None pattern
body:
Auto-fix applied by code-rescue-tool for GST_MUTABLE_DEFAULT_001 rule.

Changes (31 instances across 3 files):
- Replace `payload: Dict[str, Any] = {}` with `payload: Dict[str, Any] = None`
- Add `if payload is None: payload = {}` initialization in function body

Mutable default arguments (like `= {}` or `= []`) are shared across all
function calls, leading to subtle bugs. The None pattern ensures each
call gets a fresh instance.

Files:
- cam/routers/stub_routes.py

broken, causing all providers to have available=undefined (falsy).

subject: fix(client): centralize API calls for cross-origin deployment support
body:
Wave 26.1 - Unified API Client Migration

Problem: 207 fetch() calls using relative URLs (/api/...) failed on
Railway deployment due to cross-origin policy (frontend served from
different domain than API).

Solution:
- Enhanced apiBase.ts with resolveApiUrl() + api() drop-in fetch replacement
- api() automatically prepends VITE_API_BASE to relative URLs
- Added api.get(), api.post(), api.put(), api.delete() JSON helpers
- Created migrate_fetch_to_api.py codemod script

Migration:
- Converted 207 fetch('/api/...') calls to api('/api/...')
- Updated 81 files across components, stores, views
- Remaining 10 warnings are intentional localhost dev-mode fallbacks

Validation:
- npm run type-check passes
- validate_deployment.py --full: 0 errors, 10 warnings (down from 186)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

body:
Parametric guitar body outline generator using cubic Bézier curves:
- Two segments per side (neck→waist, waist→tail) with C¹ continuity
- BezierBodyParams dataclass with lutherie dimensions (bouts, waist, length)
- Preset configurations: dreadnought, orchestra_model, parlor, jumbo, classical, concert
- Export to DXF, SVG, and JSON formats
- Control point visualization for CAD verification

Mathematical basis:
- Γ_A(t) = (1-t)³P₀ + 3(1-t)²t·C_A1 + 3(1-t)t²·C_A2 + t³P₁
- Γ_B(t) = (1-t)³P₁ + 3(1-t)²t·C_B1 + 3(1-t)t²·C_B2 + t³P₂
- C¹ continuity at waist: C_B1 = P₁ + α·v, C_A2 = P₁ - α·v

- Parameter validation and presets

subject: feat(data): expand wood species database to 472 species (v4.0.0)
body:
Data sources:
- USDA FPL Wood Handbook (thermal conductivity, SG, Janka, MOR, MOE)
- The Wood Database (465 species with density, MOR, MOE)
- CIRAD Wood Collection (SG cross-validation from 34,395 specimens)

Guitar relevance tiers:
- Primary (19): Traditional tonewoods (spruce, mahogany, rosewood, etc.)
- Established (30): Well-known guitar woods (sapele, walnut, bubinga)
- Emerging (57): Sustainable/affordable alternatives gaining popularity
- Exploratory (366): Valid machinable woods for experimentation

Derived values (flagged with _note):
- Thermal conductivity from SG regression (k = 0.04 + 0.35 × SG)
- Specific cutting energy from SG (SCE = 0.15 + 0.65 × SG)
- Janka hardness from density power-law (bulk species)
- Machining parameters from hardness scale

Add scripts:
- bulk_import_wood_species.py: Import from Wood Database CSV
- merge_wood_data.py: Merge multiple sources with deduplication
- cross_ref_wood.py: Cross-reference against CIRAD data
- Validation and spotcheck utilities

Documentation:
- SOURCES.md: Full methodology and citations
- WOOD_SPECIES_REFERENCE.md: Quick reference with tier breakdown

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(scripts): escape regex special chars in Vue extraction analyzer
body:
The _infer_type_from_context() method was using raw binding values in
regex patterns without escaping, causing "unterminated subpattern" errors
when bindings contained special characters like () or [].

Fixes:
- Use re.escape(binding) before interpolating into patterns
- Add try/except fallback for any remaining regex errors
- Replace emoji leaf marker with ASCII "(leaf)" for Windows compatibility
- Update README to match new marker format

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

subject: feat(testing): add composable tooling improvements
body:
1. withSetup test utility (src/testing/withSetup.ts):
   - Wraps composables in Vue component context for proper testing
   - Solves "inject() can only be used inside setup()" warnings
   - Supports route mocking for composables using useRoute()
   - Includes withSetupAsync for async composables
   - Helper functions: mockRef(), mockFn()

2. Shared composable types (src/composables/types.ts):
   - BaseConfig, BaseDeps, BaseState interfaces
   - Common ref types: NullableRef, OptionalRef, ReadonlyRef
   - State patterns: LoadingState, AsyncState, FormState, ModalState
   - Domain types: Move, MachineProfile, Material, Tool, RiskLevel
   - Utility types: ComposableReturn, WritableRefs, UnwrapRefs

3. ESLint complexity rules (.eslintrc.cjs):
   - max-lines: warn at 500 lines (encourage composable extraction)
   - max-lines-per-function: warn at 100 lines

These improvements address tooling gaps identified in TOOLBOX_EVALUATION.md.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(safety): add mandatory simulation gate for G-code exports (Priority #3)
body:
Design Review 2026-02-22 Priority #3 implementation:

Schema (geometry_schemas.py):
- Add SimulationGateFields mixin with 4 fields:
  - simulation_passed: bool - whether simulation ran without critical issues
  - simulation_hash: str - SHA256 of simulation result
  - simulation_override: bool - explicit bypass flag
  - simulation_override_reason: str - required reason for override
- GcodeExportIn now inherits from SimulationGateFields

Export Router (export_router.py):
- Add RMOS_REQUIRE_SIMULATION env var (default: enabled)
- Add _check_simulation_gate() helper function
- Enforce gate in export_gcode_governed():
  - Requires simulation_passed=True OR simulation_override=True with reason
  - Raises 403 with actionable error messages if gate not satisfied
  - Logs WARNING for simulation overrides
- Store simulation metadata in RunArtifact.meta
- Add X-Simulation-Verified and X-Simulation-Hash response headers

Tests (test_simulation_gate.py):
- 9 unit tests covering:
  - Schema field existence and defaults
  - Gate logic: simulation_passed, override, no-simulation
  - Env var parsing logic

Safety gate can be disabled via RMOS_REQUIRE_SIMULATION=0 (not recommended).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(api): remove `from __future__ import annotations` to fix Pydantic v2 forward refs
body:
Remove `from __future__ import annotations` from router files that define
Pydantic models used as FastAPI request bodies. This avoids Pydantic v2
forward reference resolution issues during OpenAPI schema generation.

Files fixed:
- saw_lab/toolpaths_router.py
- api_v1/dxf_workflow.py

The issue: `from __future__ import annotations` makes all type hints strings
(PEP 563 deferred evaluation). Pydantic v2's TypeAdapter doesn't resolve
these strings during FastAPI's OpenAPI schema generation, causing:

  PydanticUserError: TypeAdapter[...ForwardRef('ModelName')...] is not fully defined

Fix: Remove `from __future__ import annotations` from modules that define
Pydantic models used in FastAPI route parameters.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

subject: fix(api): support CORS_ORIGINS env var (comma-separated list)

Docker Compose passes CORS_ORIGINS (comma-separated), but main.py only
read CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN (single value). This caused CORS preflight
failures in CI because the configured origins weren't recognized.

Fix: Parse CORS_ORIGINS env var as comma-separated list and add all
origins to the allow list. Also deduplicate entries.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(api): resolve 8 route conflicts preventing route shadowing
body:
Route conflicts occur when multiple routers register the same HTTP method + path.
FastAPI uses last-registered-wins, so earlier definitions are silently shadowed.
This was causing stub endpoints to shadow real implementations.

Fixes applied:

1. misc_stub_routes.py - Remove 5 stubs shadowing real implementations:
   - POST /ai/context/build (real: ai_context_adapter/routes.py)
   - GET /art/rosette/jobs (real: rosette_jobs_routes.py)
   - POST /art/rosette/preview (real: rosette_jobs_routes.py)
   - POST /art/rosette/compare (real: rosette_compare_routes.py)
   - GET /art/rosette/compare/snapshots (real: rosette_compare_routes.py)

2. cam/routers/stub_routes.py - Remove 1 stub shadowing real implementation:
   - GET /cam/machines (real: machines_router.py)

3. rmos/api/rmos_runs_router.py - Change prefix to avoid conflict with runs_v2:
   - /api/rmos/runs → /api/rmos/runs-index
   - runs_v2 is canonical "v2" implementation, this router now serves as index API

Also add scripts/ci/check_route_conflicts.py:
   - CI gate to prevent future route shadowing bugs
   - Parses router manifest + AST to detect duplicate routes
   - Run: python scripts/ci/check_route_conflicts.py

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(ci): add stub endpoint scanner for technical debt tracking
body:
Static analysis tool that detects stub/placeholder endpoints in FastAPI apps.
Complements check_route_conflicts.py for API quality enforcement.

Detection heuristics:
- File-level: filename contains "stub"
- Router-level: APIRouter tags contain "stub"
- Response patterns: empty lists, null IDs, "Stub:" messages
- Code patterns: TODO comments, NotImplementedError

Features:
- Confidence scoring (high/medium/low)
- JSON output for CI integration
- Filter by minimum confidence level

Usage:
  python scripts/ci/scan_stub_endpoints.py --app-root services/api/app
  python scripts/ci/scan_stub_endpoints.py --app-root services/api/app --json

Current state: 73 stub endpoints (53 high, 4 medium, 16 low confidence)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: ci: add API Wiring Gate workflow
body:
New CI workflow that runs on every API change to ensure feature network
is properly wired. Combines all three quality tools:

Checks (blocking):
1. Route Conflict Check - Fails if duplicate routes detected
2. API Wiring Verification - Fails if any of 6 checks fail:
   - Router imports
   - App startup
   - OpenAPI schema generation
   - Route conflicts
   - Critical endpoints (/health, /docs)
   - Route import health

Checks (informational):
3. Stub Endpoint Scan - Reports stub count (non-blocking)

Triggers:
- Push to main (services/api/** or scripts/ci/**)
- PR to main (services/api/**)
- Manual workflow_dispatch

Outputs:
- GitHub Step Summary with results
- Artifact upload of all logs (7-day retention)

- toolbox analyzer asks: "What does that mean?" (interpretation)

- spectrum_service.py: Visualization preparation, peak annotation
- modal_visualizer.py: Mode shape rendering, pattern classification
- design_advisor.py: Recommendations engine (wolf, bracing, thickness)
- router.py: API endpoints (/api/analyzer/*)

Boundary rules (CI-enforced):
- CAN import: core, calculators
- CANNOT import: cam, rmos, saw_lab, tap_tone_pi

Reference library includes: Martin D-28 1937, Torres FE-17, Hauser I

This is interpretation code returning home. tap_tone_pi stays measurement-only.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(business): add Engineering Cost Estimator module
body:
Parametric cost estimation for instrument builds using engineering techniques:

Complexity Factors (complexity_factors.py):
- Body: standard, cutaway, carved top, double cutaway
- Binding: none, simple, multi-ply, abalone
- Neck: bolt-on, set-neck, neck-through
- Fretboard inlay: dots, blocks, trapezoids, custom
- Finish: oil, shellac, nitro, french polish
- Rosette: simple, multi-ring, inlaid

Work Breakdown Structure (work_breakdown.py):
- ~50 tasks for acoustic dreadnought (120-150h baseline)
- Classical guitar template
- Electric solid body template
- Organized by phase: design, body, neck, assembly, finish, setup

Learning Curve (learning_curve.py):
- Crawford unit model: T_n = T_1 * n^b
- Batch size optimization
- Efficiency gain calculation

Material Yield (material_yield.py):
- Tonewood: 70-90% yield (defects, grain)
- Hardware: 98% yield
- Consumables: 70-95% yield (overspray, waste)

API Endpoints:
- POST /estimate/parametric - main estimation
- POST /estimate/quote - customer quote generation
- GET /estimate/factors - list complexity multipliers
- GET /estimate/wbs/{type} - WBS template by instrument
- GET /estimate/learning-curve - batch efficiency preview

subject: Phase 2: Duplicate code extraction — new composables + domain consolidation
body:
- 2A: Create useFetchTransform composable (fetch+transform+loading/error pattern, 16 tests)
- 2B: Create useFormState composable (form/errors/touched/isDirty, 14 tests)
- 2C: Consolidate adaptive composables:
  - Extract useLocalStorageRef (replaces 12+ localStorage read/write blocks)
  - Extract runLogHelpers (serializeMovesToSegments + buildRunLogBody)
  - Refactor useLiveLearning & useRunLogging to use shared helpers
- 2D: Deprecate computeZoomToBox (zero-logic alias for computeFitTransform)
- 2E: Consolidate rosette composables:
  - Table-driven copy actions in useClipboardExport (eliminates 9x session-guard duplication)
  - Replace downloadBlob inline code with shared util
  - WorkflowOverrides type derived from WorkflowOverridesState via Pick<>
- 2F: Unify RMOS composables:
  - useClipboardToast now composes useToast (removes 20 lines of duplicated timer logic)
  - Extract isTypingContext() to shared utils/keyboard.ts
  - useKeyboardShortcuts/useCandidateKeyboard now use shared keyboard util
  - Deprecation notices on useLegacyBulkDecision and useCandidateKeyboard

Validation: 0 type errors (vue-tsc --noEmit clean), 402 tests pass, 0 failures

1. Find schema definition
2. Search all usages across codebase
3. Find related functionality/endpoint

This distinguishes truly dead code from code that was
"not wired correctly" (like luthier_calculator.py).

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(cam): wire up Rosette Photo Batch Processor (Wave 27)
body:
Add REST API for batch rosette photo-to-SVG/DXF conversion.

New endpoints:
- POST /api/cam/rosette/photo-batch/convert - Convert uploaded images
- POST /api/cam/rosette/photo-batch/convert-urls - Convert from URLs
- GET  /api/cam/rosette/photo-batch/{batch_id} - Get batch status
- GET  /api/cam/rosette/photo-batch/{batch_id}/download - Download ZIP
- DELETE /api/cam/rosette/photo-batch/{batch_id} - Delete batch
- GET  /api/cam/rosette/photo-batch/ - List recent batches

Features:
- Parallel processing with configurable workers
- Settings: output_width_mm, threshold_method, fit_to_circle, etc.
- Auto-generates ZIP with SVG/DXF files + manifest.json
- URL-based conversion for remote images

This exposes the existing BatchProcessor class that was never wired
to an API endpoint (Feature Recovery from dead code analysis).

subject: feat(vectorizer): add acoustic features and non-strict classification mode
body:
Enhancements to vectorizer_phase2.py:

- Expand ACOUSTIC_FEATURES with archtop/Selmer-specific features:
  - D_HOLE: D-shaped soundhole (Selmer/Maccaferri)
  - F_HOLE: Archtop f-holes
  - NECK_PROFILE: Neck cross-sections
  - TAILPIECE: Selmer/archtop tailpiece
  - BRIDGE: Acoustic bridge
  - ROSETTE: Decorative rosette ring
  - HEEL_BLOCK: Neck heel block

- Add non-strict classification mode (default):
  - Uses broad size categories: BODY, LARGE, MEDIUM, SMALL, DETAIL
  - Captures ALL features without mutual exclusion
  - Prevents features from being missed due to overlapping size ranges

- Add strict_classification parameter to _extract_guitar_features()
  - strict=False (default): broad categories, captures everything
  - strict=True: attempts specific feature classification

  - HEEL_BLOCK: Neck heel block

  - Uses broad size categories: BODY, LARGE, MEDIUM, SMALL, DETAIL
  - Captures ALL features without mutual exclusion
  - Prevents features from being missed due to overlapping size ranges

- Add strict_classification parameter to _extract_guitar_features()
  - strict=False (default): broad categories, captures everything

body:
Proportional interpolation method for reverse-engineering guitar body volumes.
Validated against Martin D-28 with 99.5% accuracy.

Features:
- Elliptical cross-section integration for volume calculation
- Helmholtz resonance frequency estimation
- Dimensional ratio comparison between models
- CLI with --model, --compare, --list, --json options

Reference models included:
- Generic Dreadnought
- Martin D-28, D-18 (placeholder), OM-28, 000, 00

Usage:
  python acoustic_body_volume.py --compare martin_d28 martin_om28

Pixel Calibration Module (calibration/):
- pixel_calibrator.py: Multi-method PPI calibration (paper size, ruler, grid, body heuristic)

- 44 unit tests covering all classification scenarios

- 22 undersized results (PPI estimation without known paper size)
- Recommendation: Provide known scale length for accuracy

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(blueprint): wire calibration module + upgrade Phase 2 vectorizer
body:
Handoff Documents:
- Add BLUEPRINT_VECTORIZER_INTEGRATION_HANDOFF.md with architecture diagram
- Add VECTORIZER_UPGRADE_HANDOFF.md with 5 upgrade strategies

Calibration Router (NEW):
- POST /calibrate: Auto-calibrate with multiple methods (scale, paper, body)
- POST /calibrate/manual: Two-point user calibration
- POST /dimensions: Extract dimensions using stored calibration
- GET /calibration/{id}: Retrieve calibration result
- GET /scale-lengths: Known scale length database (Fender, Gibson, PRS)

Phase 2 Router Upgrades:
- Add calibration_id parameter for PPI-aware vectorization
- Add instrument_type (electric/acoustic) for feature classification
- Add dark_threshold (auto/0-255) for adaptive line extraction
- Add gap_close_size for broken line recovery
- Fix result key mapping (total_contours/total_lines)
- Scale correction using calibration PPI

Constants:
- Add CALIBRATION_AVAILABLE feature flag
- Add create_calibration_pipeline() factory

The vectorizer_phase2.py already has robust contour scoring using:
- Size heuristics (5%-80% of image area)
- Aspect ratio filtering (1.3-2.5 for guitars)
- Circularity and convexity checks
- Position weighting (prefers centered contours)

Test results: 0% good detections -> requires manual calibration.
UI calibration panel is next step.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(blueprint): handle large PDFs exceeding Claude 5MB image limit
body:
Large blueprint PDFs (e.g., Les Paul at 14044x9934 pixels) were failing
with "image exceeds 5 MB maximum" error from Claude API after base64
encoding.

Fixes:
- Add aggressive image resizing with pixel count limits (16M max)
- Smart initial scale estimation for images >2x the size limit
- Extended quality/scale combinations (down to 0.05 scale as last resort)
- Adaptive DPI for PDF conversion based on file size (150-300 DPI)
- Detect media type from magic bytes instead of filename after resize
- Disable PIL decompression bomb protection for large blueprints

Also:
- Fix CORS in apiBase.ts
- Update production shop features page

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(vectorizer): add SIMPLE extraction mode for non-guitar instruments
body:
Add ExtractionMode enum with SMART (default) and SIMPLE options:

- SMART: ML-based classification, optimized for guitars (existing behavior)
- SIMPLE: Raw contour extraction without filtering - works for any instrument

SIMPLE mode bypasses ML classification and extracts ALL contours above
min_area threshold using adaptive thresholding. Works for cuatros,
mandolins, and other instruments that the guitar-trained classifier
may filter out as "noise".

Usage:
  # Via constructor
  v = Phase3Vectorizer(extraction_mode=ExtractionMode.SIMPLE)

  # Via extract() override
  v.extract(source, output, extraction_mode=ExtractionMode.SIMPLE)

Tested on Cuatro blueprints: 500-600 contours vs ~60 with SMART mode.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: chore: recover 88 files (18,927 lines) from decomposition cleanup
body:
Forensic recovery of substantive code deleted across 4 cleanup waves:
- 7eefd217 (archived routers), 9566b9fd (cascade cleanup),
  298f0f68 (__REFERENCE__ purge), plus initial-commit artifacts.

Organized into 10 categories (A-J) with triage tags:
  A_cam_core:          post-processor v15.5, drilling cycles, offset math
  B_instrument_data:   Martin D-28 1937 measured data (irreplaceable)
  C_archtop_pipeline:  archtop CAM router + legacy discovery doc
  D_guitar_cam_routers: OM, Strat, registry-dynamic, smart, pipeline
  E_rosette_fabrication: traditional builder, RMOS rosette adapter
  F_validation_tooling: DXF validation, cutting evaluator, golden test
  G_rmos_orchestration: stores, presets, patterns, safety, analytics
  H_services_utilities: notifier, template engine, learning hooks
  I_experimental:      art studio, mesh ops, runs_v2, migrations
  J_reference_archive: G-code reader, Saw Lab 2.0, constraint profiles

Includes check_imports.py (dependency checker) and annotated executive
summary (README.md) with RECOVER/MINE/REFERENCE/DISCARD triage tags,
dependency satisfaction rates, and 27 phantom references audit.

No production code modified. Recovery folder only.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(specs): add Jumbo Archtop — Carlos body scale + Benedetto construction
body:
NEW hybrid archtop design combining:
- Carlos Jumbo body scale (430mm lower bout, 520mm body length)
- Benedetto 17-inch archtop construction (carved plates, f-holes, floating bridge)
- Archtop Measurements knowledge base (Mottola contour method, D'Aquisto
  graduation data, plate deflection testing)

Spec includes:
- 2 variants: venetian cutaway (22 frets) and non-cutaway (20 frets)
- Full carving parameters: top arch 22mm apex, back arch 18mm apex
- Mottola contour scale factors for CNC rough-carving
- D'Aquisto-derived graduation map adapted to jumbo scale (+5-10%)
- Plate deflection test targets (0.5-1.2mm top, 0.3-0.8mm back under 500g)
- 26 CNC operations across plates, rim, neck, and bridge
- 4-phase build workflow (plates → f-holes/bracing → assembly → setup)
- .013-.056 jazz flatwound strings (heavier gauge for larger body volume)

Also: vectorizer INSTRUMENT_SPECS entry #17 (jumbo_archtop)
Also: registry model #25 (PARTIAL status, 3 assets + 4 pending)

missing backward-compatibility functions that cam_risk_router.py and

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(docker): create runs subdirectory + set RMOS_RUNS_DIR in CI
body:
The API container was failing with PermissionError because:
1. Dockerfile created /app/services/api/app/data but not the runs/ subdirectory
2. RMOS_RUNS_DIR defaults to /data/runs which requires that subdirectory
3. CI workflows didn't override RMOS_RUNS_DIR to use /tmp

Fix:
- Dockerfile: mkdir -p /app/services/api/app/data/runs (creates both)
- proxy_parity.yml: Add RMOS_RUNS_DIR=/tmp/runs to .env
- containers.yml: Add RMOS_RUNS_DIR=/tmp/runs to .env

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

subject: Phase 3.7: Vectorizer enhancements, SVG export, CAM-ready DXF post-processor
body:
New modules:
- vectorizer_enhancements.py: 7 enhancement classes (GuitarPhotoProcessor,
  AdaptiveLineExtractor, ScaleCalibrator, ContourCompleter, DebugVisualizer,
  ManualOverride, ValidationReport) with bug fixes from spec
- export_svg.py: SVG export ported from Phase 2, mirrors DXF export signature
- dxf_postprocessor.py: ArcFitter (Kasa method), export_cam_ready_dxf() for
  R2000 LWPOLYLINE + native ARC entities, standalone postprocess_dxf()

vectorizer_phase3.py changes:
- Optional imports for all 3 new modules (try/except, graceful fallback)
- ExtractionResult extended with 7 new fields (input_type, calibration_result,
  debug_report_path, validation_report, perspective_corrected, bg_method_used,
  assembly_method)
- scale_factor param added to export_to_dxf() and applied in coordinate math
- Phase3Vectorizer.__init__() extended with 5 new params and component init
- extract() extended with 7 new params (user_dimension_mm, user_dimension_px,
  image_dpi, correct_perspective, assembly_gap_px, generate_debug_report,
  cam_ready)
- Pipeline wired: input classification, photo pre-processing, contour
  completion, manual override, enhanced scale calibration, CAM-ready DXF
  export, SVG export, enhanced validation, debug report generation

Addresses 3 commercial viability blockers:
1. LINE-only output -> LWPOLYLINE via R2000 CAM export
2. No arcs -> ArcFitter with native ARC entities
3. Scale not applied -> scale_factor in coordinate math

All changes backward compatible. 17/17 + 44/44 tests pass.

subject: feat: Photo Vectorizer V2 — standalone photo-to-SVG/DXF extractor
body:
Full 12-stage pipeline for converting guitar/instrument photos into
clean vector outlines (SVG and DXF). Designed for beginners/hobbyists
who have a concept photo but not CAD drawings.

Stages: EXIF DPI, input classification, perspective correction,
background removal (GrabCut/rembg/SAM/threshold), multi-method edge
detection (Canny+Sobel+Laplacian fusion), reference object detection,
scale calibration, contour assembly with hierarchy, feature
classification, SVG/DXF/JSON export.

Tested on Smart Guitar_1.png: body outline extracted, classified,
exported to both SVG and DXF R12 with layer organization.

- .github/workflows/dxf_validation.yml: CI workflow

subject: feat(cam): add production V-carve module with chipload + stepdown
body:
Resolves: VINE-03 (V-carve G-code is demo quality)

Upgrades over naive svg_to_naive_gcode():
- Chipload calculation: material-based feed rates (softwood, hardwood, MDF, etc.)
- Multi-pass stepdown: automatic pass count based on depth + bit angle
- V-bit geometry: depth from line width, width from depth calculations
- Corner slowdown: reduce feed at sharp corners for quality
- Path optimization: nearest-neighbor reordering to minimize rapids

New module: app/cam/vcarve/
- VCarveToolpath: production toolpath generator (@safety_critical)
- VCarveConfig: bit angle, material, target width/depth, feed params
- geometry.py: vbit_depth_for_width, vbit_width_at_depth, calculate_stepdown
- chipload.py: MATERIAL_CHIPLOAD table, calculate_feed_rate, validate_chipload

The naive implementation in toolpath/vcarve_toolpath.py is retained for
backward compatibility; new code should use app.cam.vcarve.

subject: feat(cam): add PipelineResult to CAM adapter (VEC-GAP-03)
body:
Add adapter service and API endpoint to bridge Phase 4 PipelineResult
to CAM-ready format for toolpath generation.

Service (pipeline_cam_adapter.py):
- CamReadySpec dataclass with geometry, dimensions, suggested params
- adapt_pipeline_to_cam() for PipelineResult objects
- adapt_dict_to_cam() for JSON dicts
- Auto-suggest tool params based on body dimensions

Endpoints (POST /cam/blueprint/pipeline-adapter/*):
- /from-pipeline - Convert structured PipelineResult input
- /from-pipeline-raw - Convert raw JSON dict
- /info - Adapter info

Data flow:
1. /blueprint/phase4/link-json -> PipelineResult JSON
2. /cam/blueprint/pipeline-adapter/from-pipeline -> CamReadySpec
3. CamReadySpec -> existing CAM toolpath generators

Resolves: VEC-GAP-03

subject: feat(blueprint): add Phase 1 → Phase 3 scale handoff (VEC-GAP-05)
body:
Add scale_hint_mm_per_pixel parameter to Phase 3 /vectorize endpoint:
- Accepts scale from Phase 1 AI analysis (analysis['scale']['mm_per_pixel'])
- Falls back to DPI-based calculation (25.4 / dpi) when not provided
- Response includes scale_source field ('phase1_ai' | 'dpi' | 'manual')
- Logs when Phase 1 hint is used for traceability

This enables accurate geometry sizing when AI has detected a scale
reference in the blueprint (e.g., '1/4 inch = 1 foot').

Resolves VEC-GAP-05

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(blueprint-cam): add contour reconstruction pipeline (VINE-09)
body:
Problem: Bracing DXF files contain LINE/ARC entities that are not closed
LWPOLYLINE contours. The CAM pipeline requires closed polylines for pocket
boundary definitions.

Solution: Chain LINE/ARC entities by endpoint proximity to form closed loops,
then convert each loop to a closed LWPOLYLINE.

New modules:
- contour_reconstruction.py: Core reconstruction logic
  - EntityEndpoints dataclass for tracking entity endpoints
  - ContourLoop dataclass for reconstructed contours
  - _chain_entities(): Endpoint proximity chaining algorithm
  - reconstruct_contours(): Single-layer reconstruction
  - reconstruct_bracing_dxf(): Multi-layer bracing mode

- contour_reconstruction_router.py: API endpoints
  - GET /info: Module capabilities
  - POST /reconstruct: General contour reconstruction
  - POST /reconstruct-download: Direct DXF download
  - POST /reconstruct-bracing: Specialized bracing mode

Features:
- Configurable endpoint tolerance (default 0.5mm)
- ARC to polyline conversion (16 segments)
- Layer filtering support
- Perimeter and bounds calculation
- Orphaned entity detection

Tests: 17 tests covering:
- LINE square -> 1 closed contour
- ARC circle -> 1 closed contour
- Mixed LINE/ARC -> 1 closed contour
- Two separate contours -> 2 closed contours
- Bracing layer detection
- Tolerance effects
- API endpoints

Resolves: VINE-09

subject: fix(cam): resolve drilling smoke test failures (FastAPI Body() resolution)
body:
Root cause: The @safety_critical decorator broke FastAPI's parameter
detection when combined with `from __future__ import annotations`.
The annotation was stored as a string 'DrillReq' instead of the actual
class, causing FastAPI to treat it as a Query param instead of Body.

Fixes:
- drill_router.py: Remove `from __future__ import annotations` and add
  explicit `Body()` annotation to make intent clear to FastAPI
- manifest.py: Comment out duplicate drilling router registration
  (was registered both directly and via aggregator)
- safety/__init__.py: Add `__signature__` preservation for FastAPI
  dependency injection compatibility

All 3 drilling smoke tests now pass.

subject: feat(geometry): add Martin and Benedetto headstock outlines (OM-GAP-06, BEN-GAP-06)
body:
Add two new headstock styles to neck_headstock_config.py:

Martin (OM-GAP-06):
- Slotted acoustic headstock (~190mm / 7.5" long)
- Distinctive squared shoulders
- 3+3 tuner configuration for slotted machines
- New martin_om preset (25.4" scale, 1.75" nut width)

Benedetto (BEN-GAP-06):
- Elegant archtop headstock (~175mm / 6.9" long)
- Graceful S-curves with pointed tip
- 3+3 tuner configuration
- New benedetto_archtop preset (25" scale, 1-11/16" nut width)

Both headstocks include full outline geometry (23 points each)
and proper tuner position arrays for CNC routing.

- apply_headstock_angle_2d(): 2D projection with cos(angle) foreshortening
- headstock_3d_z_at_x(): Z drop for angled headstock (17° Gibson)
- Headstock outline conversion from inches to mm
- Pydantic API models: UnifiedCanvasRequest, CanvasBoundsResponse

subject: fix(ui): install Tailwind CSS v3 to fix 706 broken utility classes
body:
The codebase had 706 Tailwind CSS utility classes (bg-*, text-*, flex-*, etc.)
across 149 Vue components but Tailwind was never installed. These classes
rendered as plain text with no styling, causing visible UI breakage.

Fix:
- Install tailwindcss@3, postcss, autoprefixer
- Add tailwind.config.js with design token integration
- Add postcss.config.js
- Add src/styles/main.css entry point with Tailwind directives
- Import main.css in main.ts

The tailwind.config.js extends the default theme with CSS variables from
design-tokens.css for consistency (colors, risk levels, surfaces).

CRITICAL fix for #15 (Tailwind/UX fixes — styles visibly broken).

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(safety): add CNC preflight fail-closed validation (#16)
body:
Implement fail-closed safety checks for CNC parameters that REFUSE to
generate G-code when parameters could result in dangerous operations.

New module: app/safety/cnc_preflight.py

Safety checks (all BLOCK generation):
- Zero RPM → tool drags through material without cutting
- Zero flutes → division-by-zero in chipload calculation
- Min feed > max feed → nonsensical clamped values
- Zero/negative depth → no material removal defined
- Zero tool diameter → undefined cutting geometry
- Invalid stepover (0% or >100%) → infinite passes or uncut material

Key functions:
- validate_cnc_params(): Returns CNCPreflightResult with safe/errors/warnings
- require_safe_cnc_params(): Raises exception on unsafe params (fail-closed)
- calculate_chipload_safe(): Safe chipload that raises instead of returning 0.0

This is the core infrastructure for #16 (CNC safety fail-closed mode).
Callers should use require_safe_cnc_params() before G-code generation.

26 tests added covering all safety checks and fail-closed philosophy.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

subject: fix(rmos): add debug logging for optional import failures
body:
The rmos/__init__.py had 9 bare `except ImportError: pass` blocks
that silently swallowed import errors. This makes debugging difficult
when optional modules have syntax errors or other issues.

Changes:
- Add logging import and _log instance
- Replace all `pass` with `_log.debug("Optional import failed: %s", e)`

Now optional import failures are logged at DEBUG level, making them
visible when troubleshooting while remaining silent in normal operation.

Resolves #29 from UNFINISHED_REMEDIATION_EFFORTS.md

- Defines expected exception types (PreflightEngineMissingError, etc.)
- Wraps cam.dxf_preflight.DXFPreflight with API translation
- Returns PreflightResult with expected attributes

Fixes one of the NotImplementedError cases from #22.

- Remove @pytest.mark.skip from test (now passing)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(art-studio): consolidate HTML prototypes into unified inlay engine
body:
Ported all geometry and pattern algorithms from inlay_designer.html and
vine_girih_generator.html into the Python Art Studio backend as one
consolidated engine sharing a single INLAY_GENERATORS registry.

Math infrastructure (inlay_geometry.py):
  - line_line_intersect: determinant-based line intersection
  - offset_polygon: miter-join polygon offset (replaces averaged-normal)
  - offset_polyline_strip: dual-rail closed strip for band patterns
  - subdivide_cubic / subdivide_quadratic: De Casteljau adaptive tessellation
  - arc_to_center_param + tessellate_arc: SVG arc → point arrays
  - tessellate_path_d: full SVG path tokeniser (all 20 commands)
  - points_to_path_d / offset_path_d: end-to-end SVG path offset pipeline
  - catmull_rom / sample_spline: Hermite cubic spline sampling
  - make_poly: unit-edge polygon from interior angles (Girih tiles)

New generators (inlay_patterns.py):
  - celtic_motif: SVG motif library (lotus, celtic_cross, triquetra)
  - vine_scroll: parametric freq-modulated vine with teardrop leaves
  - girih_rosette: 5-tile Islamic geometry (Decagon/Pentagon/Hex/Bowtie/Rhombus)
  - binding_flow: Catmull-Rom contour sampling with vine wrapping

Schema: InlayShape Literal updated from 6 → 10 shapes.
Tests: 61 passing (was 42), added 19 covering new math + generators.

- NetworkStatusBanner.vue: Offline/online status with queued ops indicator

Composables:
- useRetryQueue.ts: Retryable operations with exponential backoff + jitter
  - Deduplication by operation ID
  - Auto-process on reconnection
  - Optional localStorage persistence
  - useGlobalRetryQueue() singleton

Utils:
- errorCatalog.ts: Domain-specific error definitions
  - DXF_ERRORS: Parse, geometry, units, contours, self-intersecting
  - CAM_ERRORS: Toolpath, params, collision, G-code export
  - RMOS_ERRORS: Feasibility, override, validation

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(core): add async job queue system (Phase 3.3)
body:
Add a general-purpose async job queue for long-running operations:

Core module (app/core/job_queue/):
- queue.py: JobQueue class with priority scheduling, workers, retries
- schemas.py: Pydantic models for requests/responses
- router.py: REST API endpoints for job management

Features:
- Priority-based scheduling (low/normal/high/critical)
- Background worker pool with asyncio
- Idempotency key deduplication
- Configurable retries with exponential backoff
- Job cancellation and retry support
- Progress tracking for running jobs
- Queue statistics endpoint
- Webhook callbacks on completion

Endpoints:
- POST /api/jobs - Submit new job
- GET /api/jobs - List jobs with filters
- GET /api/jobs/{id} - Get job status
- POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel - Cancel job
- POST /api/jobs/{id}/retry - Retry failed job
- GET /api/jobs/stats - Queue statistics
- GET /api/jobs/health - Health check

Tests: 28 tests (unit + integration)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: refactor: decompose large modules into focused sub-modules
body:
Split three large modules to improve maintainability:

1. inlay_engines.py (1,270 → 46 lines)
   Split into engines/ package:
   - grid_engine.py (294 lines): GridConfig + GridEngine
   - radial_engine.py (335 lines): RadialConfig + RadialEngine
   - path_engine.py (409 lines): PathConfig + PathEngine
   - medallion_engine.py (249 lines): MedallionEngine classes

2. inlay_geometry.py (1,138 → 128 lines)
   Split into 6 focused modules:
   - inlay_geometry_core.py: Base types and utilities
   - inlay_geometry_bezier.py: Bezier curve operations
   - inlay_geometry_transforms.py: Geometric transformations
   - inlay_geometry_rope.py: Rope/twist geometry
   - inlay_geometry_svg.py: SVG rendering
   - inlay_geometry_bom.py: Bill of materials calculation

3. gcode_parser.py + gcode_reader.py (1,283 → 79 lines total)
   Merged and split into gcode/ package:
   - types.py: Move, Summary, MoveSegment, Modal dataclasses
   - lexer.py: Tokenization and comment stripping
   - geometry.py: Arc calculations and interpolation
   - simulator.py: State machine simulation
   - reader.py: File parsing and validation
   - render.py: SVG visualization
   - report.py: Human-readable reports and CSV/JSON export
   - cli.py: Command-line interface

All original modules now re-export from sub-modules for backward
compatibility. Test fix: TestHerringbone expects kind="polygon".

subject: fix(agentic): fix replay mode/shadow_mode precedence logic
body:
The smoke test expects shadow_mode=True to mean M0 (no emit),
while golden tests expect explicit mode="M1" to mean emit.

Fix:
- Change mode default to None (auto-detect from shadow_mode)
- Explicit mode (M0/M1) takes precedence over shadow_mode
- If mode=None, derive from shadow_mode: True->M0, False->M1
- Add summary dict with total_sessions and total_events
- Use event_count instead of events_processed (matches test API)
- Add would_have_emitted to diagnostic in shadow mode

subject:
Patch 17: ContourMerger + X-extent guard + coin position filter

Three root-cause fixes for dimensional accuracy:
1. ContourMerger — fills fragmented body contours onto mask, morphological
   close, re-detect as single contour (targets Smart Guitar H=41% error)
2. elect_body_contour_v2 — X-extent guard rejects contours wider than
   body_region.width * 1.30 (targets Archtop W=112% error)
3. filter_coin_by_position — rejects coin candidates whose centre is
   inside fg_mask (targets Benedetto H=68% false coin detection)

Pipeline wiring:
- ContourMerger instantiated in __init__, invoked at Stage 8.1
- elect_body_contour_v2 replaces naive body election at Stage 8.2
- filter_coin_by_position injected into ReferenceObjectDetector.detect()
- fg_mask passed through ScaleCalibrator.calibrate() to detect()

Live test results vs pre-Patch-17 baseline:
- Archtop W: 111.7% -> 22.6% (improved -89pp) — X-extent guard working
- Smart Guitar H: 41.3% -> 32.9% (improved -8pp) — merger partially helped
- Smart Guitar W: 5.2% -> 95.4% (REGRESSED) — needs investigation
- Benedetto: unchanged — coin filter did not trigger

Tests: 127/127 pass (38 v2 + 33 BOM + 29 patch-14/13/15 + 27 patch-17)"

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(photo-vectorizer): contour plausibility scorer + typed stage result
body:
Implements Step 1-3 of the agreed engineering plan:

1. ContourScore dataclass: 7 plausibility signals (solidity, border contact,
   neck inclusion, aspect ratio, dimension plausibility, symmetry, completeness).
   Each scored contour carries composite score 0-1 with diagnostic issues list.

2. ContourStageResult dataclass: full typed record of Stage 8 processing -
   pre-merge contours, merge result, post-merge contours, scoring results for
   both candidate sets, elected source, best score, export blocking status.

3. ContourPlausibilityScorer class: family-aware dimension priors from
   INSTRUMENT_SPECS, 7 scoring signals weighted into composite score,
   pre-merge vs post-merge comparison via elect_best().
   Currently DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - scores all candidates and captures results
   in ContourStageResult but does NOT override proven elect_body_contour_v2.

4. Export blocking gate: if best plausibility score < 0.30 threshold,
   SVG/DXF/JSON export is skipped with warning + diagnostics.

5. PhotoExtractionResult gets contour_stage, export_blocked, export_block_reason
   fields for downstream consumers.

Wired into extract() Stage 8: snapshots pre/post merge contours, scores both
candidate sets, builds ContourStageResult, attaches to result. Proven Patch 17
body election (elect_body_contour_v2 + X-extent guard) unchanged.

158/158 tests pass (127 existing + 31 new). Zero regressions.

Implements Step 1-3 of the agreed engineering plan:

1. ContourScore dataclass: 7 plausibility signals (solidity, border contact,
   neck inclusion, aspect ratio, dimension plausibility, symmetry, completeness).
   Each scored contour carries composite score 0-1 with diagnostic issues list.

2. ContourStageResult dataclass: full typed record of Stage 8 processing -
   pre-merge contours, merge result, post-merge contours, scoring results for
   both candidate sets, elected source, best score, export blocking status.

3. ContourPlausibilityScorer class: family-aware dimension priors from
   INSTRUMENT_SPECS, 7 scoring signals weighted into composite score,
   pre-merge vs post-merge comparison via elect_best().
   Currently DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - scores all candidates and captures results
   in ContourStageResult but does NOT override proven elect_body_contour_v2.

4. Export blocking gate: if best plausibility score < 0.30 threshold,
   SVG/DXF/JSON export is skipped with warning + diagnostics.

5. PhotoExtractionResult gets contour_stage, export_blocked, export_block_reason
   fields for downstream consumers.

Wired into extract() Stage 8: snapshots pre/post merge contours, scores both
candidate sets, builds ContourStageResult, attaches to result. Proven Patch 17
body election (elect_body_contour_v2 + X-extent guard) unchanged.

158/158 tests pass (127 existing + 31 new). Zero regressions.
