author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(vectorizer): implement 3 blocking fixes from DEVELOPER_HANDOFF.md
body:
Photo Vectorizer v2 upgrade - all 3 blocking issues now addressed:

1. Two-pass calibration (BLOCKER 1):
   - ContourStage.run() now accepts spec_name parameter
   - When scale source is ASSUMED_DPI or ESTIMATED_RENDER_DPI and spec_name
     is provided, finds body contour height and recalibrates
   - Pass 2 re-classifies all contours with corrected mm_per_px
   - Fixes the root cause of dimension misclassification

2. Reference object false-positive fix (BLOCKER 2):
   - Tightened HoughCircles: param2 30→50, radii 20-200→30-100
   - Reordered calibration priority: when spec_name is explicitly provided,
     INSTRUMENT_SPEC now takes priority over REFERENCE_OBJECT
   - User intent ("this is a smart guitar") outranks speculative detection

3. Contour deduplication (BLOCKER 3):
   - Added _deduplicate_concentric() to ContourAssembler
   - Removes contours with bbox IoU > 0.85 with body contour
   - Eliminates phantom inner-edge traces that caused false NECK_POCKET

All fixes are "Small" effort per DEVELOPER_HANDOFF.md spec.

subject: feat(cam): implement archtop bridge and saddle DXF generators
body:
Add complete implementations for archtop guitar CAM components:

archtop_bridge_generator.py:
- Generates floating bridge DXF with layers for outline, post holes, string slots
- Supports configurable post spacing, dimensions, and string spacing
- Outputs rounded corner bridge base with thumb wheel post holes

archtop_saddle_generator.py:
- Generates compensated saddle profile DXF with crowned top
- Supports per-string intonation compensation offsets
- Includes layers for profile, blank outline, notches, and compensation indicators

archtop_cam_router.py:
- Wire /bridge endpoint to call generate_bridge_dxf()
- Wire /saddle endpoint to call generate_saddle_dxf()
- Load fit parameters from JSON file, generate timestamped output

Resolves NotImplementedError for archtop bridge/saddle endpoints.

subject: feat(db): add PostgreSQL support to RMOS stores (Store Migration)
body:

- Auto-detect backend from DATABASE_URL environment variable
- postgresql:// or postgres:// → PostgreSQL backend
- sqlite:// or default → SQLite backend

- Separate schema initialization for each backend

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(api): add API rate limiting middleware using slowapi
body:
Implement comprehensive rate limiting to protect against abuse and ensure
fair usage across all API consumers.

Rate Limit Tiers:
- Public/unauthenticated: 30 requests/minute
- Authenticated (free): 60 requests/minute
- Authenticated (pro): 300 requests/minute
- AI endpoints: 10 requests/minute (expensive operations)
- CAM/CNC endpoints: 20 requests/minute (computational)
- File uploads: 10 requests/minute
- Health/docs: Unlimited (exempt)

New files:
- middleware/rate_limit.py: Rate limiter config, helpers, decorators
- tests/test_rate_limit_middleware.py: Unit tests for rate limiting

Integration:
- main.py: Add limiter state and exception handler
- Decorators applied to critical endpoints:
  - /api/vision/segment (AI tier)
  - /api/adaptive/gcode (CAM tier)
  - /api/v1/dxf/upload (upload tier)

Configuration via environment:
- RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=0 to disable
- RATE_LIMIT_STORAGE=redis://... for distributed limiting
- RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT to override default limit

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(cam): add modular neck CNC pipeline with full-scale station awareness (LP-GAP-03)
body:
Add comprehensive neck machining pipeline that extends profile carving beyond
the 12" limit to cover complete neck length including heel:

Modules (services/api/app/cam/neck/):
- config.py: NeckPipelineConfig, TrussRodConfig, ProfileCarvingConfig,
  FretSlotConfig, NeckToolSpec, presets (Les Paul, Strat, Classical)
- truss_rod_channel.py: Multi-pass rectangular pocket with access pocket
- profile_carving.py: Full-scale station-aware profile carving (C/D/V/U/Compound)
  with roughing and finishing passes, finish allowance support
- fret_slots.py: 12-TET fret positions with compound radius depth adjustment
- orchestrator.py: Chains operations into complete CNC program

Key features:
- Dynamic station generation via get_station_y_positions() - not limited to 12"
- VINE-05 coordinate system: Y=0 at nut, +Y toward bridge
- Compound profile blending (V→C transition along neck length)
- Compound radius fretboard support with depth compensation
- Preview methods for stations and fret positions without G-code generation

Tests: 38 passing (test_neck_cnc_pipeline.py)
- Configuration and preset tests
- 12-TET fret position math verification
- Full-scale station coverage tests
- Integration tests for Les Paul and Strat pipelines

subject: feat(cam): add centralized post-processor module (LP-GAP-06)
body:
Add app/cam/post_processor.py — standardized G-code generation for:
- G43 tool length compensation (automatic after M6)
- G41/G42 cutter radius compensation (climb/conventional milling)
- Tool change sequencing with M0/M1 pause modes
- Controller-specific dialects (GRBL, Mach3, Haas, LinuxCNC, Fanuc)
- Program header/footer with safety blocks (G21/G90/G17/G40/G49/G80)

Classes:
- PostProcessor: Main class for G-code generation
- PostConfig: Configuration (emit_g43, pause_mode, safe_z, controller)
- ToolSpec: Tool definition (number, diameter, rpm, offset registers)
- ToolChangeMode: NONE, M0 (mandatory), M1 (optional), DWELL

Convenience functions:
- generate_tool_change(): Standalone tool change sequence
- generate_cutter_comp_sequence(): G41/G42 start/cancel pair

29 tests covering all features.

when the context exits, making the returned dxf_path and svg_path
invalid for download.

Fix: Use tempfile.mkdtemp() like Phase 2 does, so output files persist
and can be downloaded after the response is returned.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(instrument): add bridge saddle compensation calculator
body:
Two modes:
- MODE 1 (Design): Semi-empirical compensation from string specs
  - estimate_string_compensation_mm() using gauge/tension/action/scale
  - fit_straight_saddle() least-squares for saddle slant angle
  - build_design_report() with per-string residuals and recommendation
- MODE 2 (Setup): Adjustment from measured cents error
  - compute_saddle_adjustment() using delta_L = scale × (2^(e/1200) - 1)
  - build_setup_result() with new compensation positions

Endpoints:
- POST /api/instrument/bridge/compensation (design mode)
- POST /api/instrument/bridge/setup (setup mode)

28 tests covering:
- Wound vs plain compensation differential
- Gauge/action/tension dependencies
- Least squares fit residuals sum to zero
- +5 cents sharp → positive delta_L
- -5 cents flat → negative delta_L

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(vision): resolve Pydantic ForwardRef error in segmentation router
body:
Root cause: `from __future__ import annotations` (PEP 563) defers type
evaluation, causing UploadFile to become a ForwardRef that Pydantic 2.x
can't resolve when combined with Form() parameters.

Fix:
- Remove `from __future__ import annotations` from segmentation_router.py
- Add explicit typing imports instead
- Add NOTE comment explaining why future annotations must not be used

Test:
- Remove skip decorator from test_segment_rejects_invalid_content_type
- Test now passes: verifies text/plain upload returns ok=False

All 28 vision segmentation tests pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

subject: feat(acoustics): add radius dish router for parametric G-code generation
body:
Add radius_dish_router.py with endpoints:
- POST /api/acoustics/radius-dish/generate-gcode — spherical dish G-code
- POST /api/acoustics/radius-dish/calculate — dish depth/geometry
- POST /api/acoustics/radius-dish/brace-camber — pre-bend calculation
- GET  /api/acoustics/radius-dish/common-radii — reference table

Uses exact sphere equation Z = R - sqrt(R² - x² - y²) for toolpath.
Supports any radius (not just 15ft/25ft), roughing+finishing passes.

Register in acoustics_manifest.py (100 routers now loaded).

subject: feat(api): add LTB Calculator Router with 11 endpoints (Session B-2)
body:
Add /api/ltb/calculator endpoint suite exposing the LTB Calculator classes:

Endpoints:
- POST /evaluate - Expression evaluation (scientific calculator)
- POST /fraction/convert - Decimal to fraction conversion
- GET /fraction/parse/{text} - Parse fraction string
- POST /tvm - Time Value of Money calculation
- POST /radius/from-3-points - Circle radius from 3 points
- POST /radius/from-chord - Radius from chord and height
- POST /radius/compound - Compound radius at position
- POST /wedge/angle - Wedge angle calculation
- POST /board-feet - Board feet calculation
- GET /miter/{num_sides} - Miter angle for polygon
- GET /dovetail/{ratio} - Dovetail angle from ratio

All 16 tests pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(ai): D-3 lutherie system prompt — 6 encoding principles + tonewood values
body:
Add lutherie_system_prompt.py with comprehensive domain knowledge:

1. DOMAIN AUTHORITY: Master luthier + acoustic engineer persona
2. REFERENCE GROUNDING: Scale lengths, neck angles, fret math, radius specs,
   soundboard thickness, X-brace angles, tonewood acoustic properties
3. CALCULATION AWARENESS: Formulas + redirect to /api/ltb/calculator endpoints
4. PHYSICS VOCABULARY: Acoustic impedance, Young's modulus, Helmholtz resonance,
   orthotropic properties, Q factor, radiation coefficient
5. HISTORICAL REFERENCE: Torres, Martin, Gibson, Fender, Somogyi, Smallman
6. BUILD DECISION FRAMING: Acoustic tradeoffs, not vague preferences

Values extracted from luthier_tonewood_reference.json (71 woods) and
LTBLuthierCalculator module.

Includes compact version for token-constrained contexts.

subject: feat(calculators): ACOUSTIC-002 saddle force decomposition
body:
Add saddle force calculator with per-string vertical force computation.

Formula: F_saddle_i = T_i × (sin(θ_front_i) + sin(θ_behind_i))

Calculator (services/api/app/calculators/saddle_force_calc.py):
- StringForce dataclass: string_name, tension_n, break_angle_deg, behind_angle_deg, vertical_force_n
- SaddleForceResult dataclass: string_forces, total_vertical_force_n, total_vertical_force_lbs, gate, notes
- compute_saddle_force() function with per-string breakdown
- compute_saddle_force_simple() for aggregate calculation
- Gate thresholds: GREEN <500N, YELLOW 500-700N, RED >700N

Endpoint (POST /api/instrument/saddle-force):
- Accepts string_tensions_n, break_angles_deg, body_depth_at_bridge_mm, pin_to_tailblock_mm
- Returns per-string forces, total, gate, and notes

Tests (10 tests):
- Standard light strings → GREEN gate
- Heavy strings → YELLOW gate
- Steeper break angle → higher force
- Total force = sum of per-string forces
- Gate RED >700N
- Behind angle computation
- Endpoint smoke tests

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(calculators): ACOUSTIC-003 top deflection calculator — orthotropic plate under saddle load
body:
Implements first-principles top deflection model using simply-supported beam
approximation with orthotropic plate properties and brace stiffness contribution.

Formula: δ = F × a² × b² / (3 × EI × (a + b))
Creep projection: +35% lifetime estimate

New files:
- app/calculators/top_deflection_calc.py
  - PlateProperties dataclass (E_L, E_C, thickness, length, width, density)
  - BraceContribution dataclass (brace_EI, brace_count)
  - DeflectionResult dataclass with gate (GREEN/YELLOW/RED)
  - compute_plate_EI() — bare plate longitudinal bending stiffness
  - compute_composite_EI() — plate + brace contribution
  - compute_top_deflection() — main calculator with bridge position
  - Wood species defaults: SPRUCE_SITKA, SPRUCE_ENGELMANN, CEDAR_WESTERN_RED

- POST /api/instrument/top-deflection endpoint

Gate thresholds:
  GREEN:  total < 1.5 mm  (acceptable)
  YELLOW: 1.5 <= total < 3.0 mm  (monitor)
  RED:    total >= 3.0 mm  (structural risk)

Tests: 12/12 passing (8 unit + 3 endpoint smoke + 1 validation)

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(calculators): ACOUSTIC-004 inverse brace sizing from deflection target
body:
Add inverse solver to bracing_calc.py that computes required brace
dimensions from a target deflection limit:

- BraceSizingTarget dataclass: max_deflection_mm, applied_load_n, etc.
- RequiredBraceSpec dataclass: dimensions, gate (ACHIEVABLE/MARGINAL/NOT_ACHIEVABLE)
- compute_required_EI(): inverse of deflection formula
- compute_brace_dimensions_for_EI(): solve for height from EI
- solve_brace_sizing(): full inverse solver combining both functions

Formulas:
- EI = F × a² × b² / (3 × δ_static × L)
- For rectangular: h = cbrt(12 × EI / (E × w))
- For parabolic: h = cbrt(175 × EI / (8 × E × w))

Gate thresholds: ≤10mm → ACHIEVABLE, 10-14mm → MARGINAL, >14mm → NOT_ACHIEVABLE

Add POST /api/instrument/brace-sizing endpoint.

Tests: 6 unit + 3 endpoint smoke tests (9 total).

1. EdgeFlowExtractor O(n²) → O(n): Replace triple nested loop with
   iterative cv2.filter2D box filter (10 iterations, 3x3 kernel).
   Maintains edge strength propagation semantics.

2. DXF format R12 → R2010: Modern format supports all required
   entity types for downstream CAM toolchain.

3. GridClassifierWrapper: Wire _classification_to_certainty() to
   grid_classify.PhotoGridClassifier output format:
   - Maps zone names (UL, MC, LR, etc.) to grid cells
   - Scales 3x3 zone grid to arbitrary grid_size
   - Falls back to relative_x/y positioning

Also: Remove preamble/trailing prose that caused SyntaxError on import.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: feat(smart-guitar): neck angle analysis vs Explorer baseline
body:
Explorer: 8mm TOM at 4.5 deg is Gibson spec, but solver computes 1.35 deg.
Solver has ~3.15 deg offset from real-world Gibson geometry.

Smart Guitar sweep (neck_joint_fret=19, headless bridge 10-14mm):
- 10mm bridge → 1.68° (solver) → ~4.8° (real-world estimate)
- 12mm bridge → 2.22° (solver) → ~5.4° (real-world estimate)
- 14mm bridge → 2.77° (solver) → ~5.9° (real-world estimate)

Conclusion: Headless bridges sit higher than TOM, so Smart Guitar
likely needs angle STEEPER than Explorer 4.5°, not Les Paul 4.0°.

Neck angle CANNOT be finalized until bridge model is selected.
Blocks OP20 neck pocket routing.

subject: feat(photo-vectorizer): multi-view shape reconstructor
body:
Visual hull reconstruction from 2-4 calibrated photos.
Runs existing extractor per view, aligns to common
coordinate system, intersects silhouettes to tighten
the top-view profile.

No instrument identification — pure geometry output.
DXF export matches generate_smart_guitar_v3_dxf format.
Works on any object — guitar bodies, templates, blanks.

Features:
- Top view required, front/side/back optional refiners
- Scale calibration from ruler or known reference
- Silhouette intersection clips out-of-range points
- Shapely polygon clipping when available, fallback otherwise
- DXF output with single BODY_OUTLINE layer (R2010 format)
- CLI: --top, --front, --side, --output, --calibration

Tests:
- Top-only reconstruction returns valid contour
- Front + top clips points outside front projection
- Output DXF has single BODY_OUTLINE layer

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(smart-guitar): change CENTERLINE linetype to CONTINUOUS to prevent viewer hang
body:
The CENTERLINE layer was referencing the CENTER linetype, but this linetype
was never loaded into the DXF document's LTYPE table. This caused DXF viewers
to hang indefinitely trying to resolve the undefined linetype reference.

Fix: Use CONTINUOUS linetype instead. The centerline geometry is unchanged -
only the dash pattern is lost until proper linetype loading is implemented.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(smart-guitar): relocate control cavity + fix wiring topology
body:
Position fix (structural clearance):
- Move control_plate_surface and control_cavity from x=55.2, y=346.7
  to x=25.0, y=317.0 (between bridge pickup and headless bridge lines)
- Old position had only 9.7mm edge clearance — structurally marginal
- New position has 34mm clearance — safe for router pass

Wiring topology fix:
- Route 1: Neck pickup → control cavity (was: → Teensy)
- Route 2: Bridge pickup → control cavity (was: → Teensy)
- Route 3: Control cavity → output jack (was: Pi → output jack)
- Route 4: Teensy → Pi 5 USB serial (I/O data only, no audio)

Pi 5 is NOT in passive audio chain. Signal path is:
  Pickups → Control Cavity (pots/selector) → Output Jack → Scarlett Solo

Single "Pickups and Controls Access Panel" covers both bridge pickup
route and control cavity on rear face.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

subject: fix(tests): prevent test pollution by clearing dependency_overrides
body:
The global client fixture in conftest.py now clears dependency_overrides
before and after each test. This prevents state pollution from tests
that set dependency overrides (e.g., test_auth_router.py setting
get_current_principal override), which was causing 12 manufacturing
candidate tests to fail with 401 Unauthorized.

Changes:
- Use context manager (with TestClient(app)) for proper cleanup
- Clear app.dependency_overrides before creating TestClient
- Clear app.dependency_overrides after test completes

This ensures header-based auth works correctly regardless of test order.

author: HanzoRazer
subject: fix(tests): prevent AUTH_MODE pollution in manufacturing candidate tests
body:
The client fixture was failing with 401 errors when running deep into the
full test suite (around 59%). Earlier tests would change AUTH_MODE or set
dependency_overrides that polluted the auth module's cached AUTH_MODE value.

Fix:
- Add monkeypatch parameter to client fixture
- Force AUTH_MODE="header" via monkeypatch.setattr before each test
- This ensures header-based auth (x-user-role, x-user-id) works regardless
  of what earlier tests may have done to the auth module

The root cause is that AUTH_MODE is read from environment at module import
time (auth/deps.py line 36) and cached. When tests modify this cached value
or set dependency_overrides, subsequent tests inherit the polluted state.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

subject: feat(woodworking): add logarithmic concha spiral soundhole generator
body:
Add nautilus-inspired spiral soundhole generator with DXF export:

soundhole_spiral.py:
- SpiralSoundholeSpec dataclass with bout_radius, slot_width, turns, growth_rate
- compute_spiral_geometry() returns centerline, walls, area, perimeter, P:A ratio
- generate_dxf() creates R2000 DXF with layers:
  SPIRAL_CENTERLINE, SPIRAL_OUTER_WALL, SPIRAL_INNER_WALL, BOUT_REFERENCE
- Mathematical basis: r(θ) = r_start × e^(k × θ)

woodworking_router.py:
- POST /api/woodworking/soundhole/spiral/geometry - compute geometry
- POST /api/woodworking/soundhole/spiral/dxf - download DXF file

Tests:
- 10 unit tests for geometry, P:A ratio, DXF export, edge cases
